purpose: Bind the frozen training corpus to its upstream molecular source. The dataset freeze proves WHICH BYTES; it did not record WHICH CORPUS. This closes that gap as far as the artifacts allow and states plainly what remains open.

empirical_corroboration.note: Measured on 4,000 randomly sampled training sources, independent of any config.
empirical_corroboration.molecular_weight_p90_reading: a hard MW <= 500 filter, consistent with GuacaMol
empirical_corroboration.element_reading: exactly the ORGANIC_VOCABULARY set (C,N,O,F,S,P,Cl,Br,I,B) including boron, which is a distinctive fingerprint; rules OUT ZINC250k, which carries no boron and effectively no phosphorus

matched_validation_reserve.near_duplicate_status: cluster-disjoint BY CONSTRUCTION (ECFP4 Tanimoto >= 0.95, formula- and scaffold-blocked, 2,431,365 pairs compared exhaustively)

external_16_shard_cohort.method: every cohort source sharing a training scaffold was compared against every training molecule on that scaffold

panels.final_test: NOT AUDITED -- the role is sealed and uncompiled (33,683 source records exist). Must be audited before the final test is opened.

leakage_audit.reading: Both evaluation panels are exactly disjoint AND near-duplicate disjoint from the training source universe. The reserve's higher scaffold sharing (81% vs 59%) is by design: it was carved from the same population, which is what makes it population-matched.

resolved_questions.training_authorized_false: NOT a live blocker. The flag appears on ALL 20 editing_v2 configs, including gate_zero_structural, capability_cells, t1_panel_policy and active8_decision_runtime -- every one of which the training run actually reads. It is a project-wide convention meaning a frozen design artifact does not itself confer training authority.

open_links: The Active8 run 8ecc0e5e... records NO source asset in any of its four receipts, and its transition records carry no provenance field. The link from the trained corpus to the GuacaMol asset is inferred from configs and corroborated empirically, not recorded in the artifact chain.

It CANNOT be closed by subset-testing: the lane is executor_generated_walk_from_real_endpoint, so only the ENDPOINTS are GuacaMol molecules and walked intermediate sources will not appear in any GuacaMol file.

The MMP pool's own upstream molecule source is unresolved. Its contract at /artifacts/mmp_pool_frozen_v2/.../MMP_POOL_COMPLETE.json was not retrievable at that path on the compose-v4-artifacts volume.
methods_wording: The editing corpus was derived from a fixed 500,000-molecule GuacaMol source pool by compiling executable local transitions, real-endpoint analogue relations, and reversible synthetic walks. COMPOSE was NOT trained as an unconditional GuacaMol distribution model: the learned object is R_theta(y|x), a transition law over source-successor edits, not p_theta(x).
confidence: HIGH that the source pool is GuacaMol-derived and NOT ZINC250k, on two independent grounds (config declarations with SHA-256, and measured molecular statistics). NOT absolute, because one end-to-end artifact binding is missing.
